description: Eight authored regression scenarios, each evaluated for Broadcaster, Liverpool fan and Analyst. Expectations are a starting rubric for review, not human-labelled ground truth or measured model performance.

cases.rubric: A new, evidenced pressing or momentum change merits a fresh update. Explain only what the selected facts establish.
The new Liverpool goal and 2–1 score should take priority over routine tactical updates. Do not invent the finish or its tactical cause.
City's new dismissal and player disadvantage deserve an update. Do not claim a tactical outcome has already happened without supporting evidence.
An uneventful opening with no verified candidates should not call either model or invent an update.
These same verified stories were just aired five real seconds ago. Respect the viewer's interruption cadence; choose NONE.
Every candidate's live window has expired. Skip model calls and retain the previous aired card rather than publishing stale evidence.
The exact goal event has already aired and other updates are still fresh. Do not repeat the goal or immediately interrupt with a routine story.
The exact dismissal has already aired and other updates are still fresh. Do not repeat the red card or fabricate another development.
